usage: cox runs clean [-h] --repo REPO [--worktree-root WORKTREE_ROOT] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                      [--profile PROFILE] [--apply] [--force]
                      run_id

positional arguments:
  run_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO
  --worktree-root WORKTREE_ROOT
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   override: resolve task records here instead of the profile's workspace_dir
  --profile PROFILE
  --apply
  --force               delete every branch regardless of whether its task is on main
